prompt: query.py has a bug. parse_query(qs) parses a URL query string into a dict. A key that appears ONCE maps to its string value; a key that appears MORE THAN ONCE maps to the list of its values in order. A part with no '=' maps to ''. An empty string parses to {}. Symptom: parse_query('a=1&a=2') returns {'a': '2'} — the first value is lost — expected {'a': ['1', '2']}. Single-occurrence keys already work. Do not change the signature.
